prompt: Cho cấp số cộng <math display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><semantics><mrow><mo stretchy="true" form="prefix">(</mo><msub><mi>u</mi><mi>n</mi></msub><mo stretchy="true" form="postfix">)</mo></mrow></semantics></math> có công sai <math display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><semantics><mrow><mi>d</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>11</mn></mrow></semantics></math>. Khẳng định nào sau đây đúng?
solution: Theo định nghĩa cấp số cộng, ta có <math display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><semantics><mrow><msub><mi>u</mi><mrow><mi>n</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow></msub><mo>=</mo><msub><mi>u</mi><mi>n</mi></msub><mo>+</mo><mi>d</mi></mrow></semantics></math>, suy ra <math display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><semantics><mrow><msub><mi>u</mi><mrow><mi>n</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow></msub><mo>=</mo><msub><mi>u</mi><mi>n</mi></msub><mo>+</mo><mn>11</mn></mrow></semantics></math>, <math display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><semantics><mrow><mo>∀</mo><mi>n</mi><mo>∈</mo><msup><mi>ℕ</mi><mo>*</mo></msup></mrow></semantics></math>.
